0022600153.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder (4-1, 1st in the Northwest and 3rd in the West) visit the Houston Rockets (5-1, 2nd in the West) in the Thunder's sixth game of the season, with both teams having just dropped their most recent game. Oklahoma City is missing Alex Caruso, Cason Wallace, Chet Holmgren, Jalen Williams, Nikola Topic, and Thomas Sorber, while Houston is without Steven Adams and has Reed Sheppard listed as day-to-day and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Thunder won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, though Oklahoma City lost the most recent meeting 112-106 at home on February 7, 2026.
